About This Data

Total Value Locked (TVL) measures the total amount of cryptocurrency deposited into DeFi protocols on a given blockchain. It is the primary metric used to assess the health and adoption of a blockchain ecosystem.

This data is sourced from DeFiLlama, the largest DeFi data aggregator, which tracks over 186 chains and thousands of protocols. TVL changes daily as users deposit and withdraw from lending protocols, liquidity pools, and yield aggregators. A rising TVL indicates growing user confidence and capital inflows into the ecosystem.
